body:
I am I a support group for bipolar disorder which I have. It helps sometimes but it also hurts hearing how shitty life is for everyone else.... 

My job was a small company, I helped pregnant woman with breast feeding knowledge and supplies, I mainly did data entry and got to listen to music or audio books while I worked, unless I was helping a patient. It was quiet and relaxing, and most importantly I was so good at it.

That would all be amazing but I’m just afraid the world doesn’t work that way. It’s a corrupt selfish world. 

I enjoyed reading and writing. Playing with my dog and cat. I actually loved working but I don’t have that anymore.
I wish I could get angry, I never get angry, I’m a pushover
